facts.value: According to Ibn Khaldun, most of the books were thrown into the Tigris in 1258. Legend adds that the river ran black with ink for days.
facts.quote: according to Ibn Khaldūn, most of their contents were thrown into the river Tigris [7] . Legend has it that the river flowed black with ink for days afterwards
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/fate-of-manuscripts-iraq-elsewhere/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'Legend has it that the river flowed black with ink for days afterwards'

facts.value: Not every Baghdad library fell in 1258. The Nizamiya and Mustansiriya libraries were not destroyed and stayed in use much later.
facts.quote: were not destroyed and continued to be used until much later
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/fate-of-manuscripts-iraq-elsewhere/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'were not destroyed and continued to be used until much later'

facts.value: It is reported that the caliph paid the translator Hunayn the weight of his translated books in gold. This is a report, not a proven fact.
facts.quote: It is reported that the Caliph used to give him the equivalent weight in gold to that of the books he had translated into Arabic
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/abbasids-house-wisdom-baghdad/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'used to give him the equivalent weight in gold'

facts.value: Baghdad lost a great library long before the Mongols. In 1059 the Seljuks burnt and pillaged the House of Knowledge founded by Sabur ibn Ardashir.
facts.quote: the conquering Seljuks burnt and pillaged the illustrious
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/fate-of-manuscripts-iraq-elsewhere/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'the conquering Seljuks burnt and pillaged the illustrious'

facts.value: Hunayn ibn Ishaq is said to have chosen the thickest paper for his translations and told his scribes to use big letters and wide margins.
facts.quote: Hunayn used to choose for his translated books the thickest of the paper
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/abbasids-house-wisdom-baghdad/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'Hunayn used to choose for his translated books the thickest of the paper'

facts.value: Al-Ma'mun is said to have asked the Byzantine emperor for permission to send scholars to translate books held in the empire. The emperor agreed.
facts.quote: requested the Byzantine Emperor at the time for permission to send some of his scientists
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/abbasids-house-wisdom-baghdad/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'requested the Byzantine Emperor at the time for permission to send some of his scientists'

events.label: The Seljuks burnt the House of Knowledge in Baghdad, with holdings put at 10,000 volumes.
events.quote: destroying or dispersing its entire holdings estimated at 10,000 volumes
events.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://muslimheritage.com/fate-of-manuscripts-iraq-elsewhere/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'destroying or dispersing its entire holdings estimated at 10,000 volumes'
